info.name: SnipSlot API
info.description:
REST API for the SnipSlot barber booking PWA.

Set `ownerToken` and `customerToken` in the environment first: sign in on the web app, then copy the value of the `snipslot_session` cookie from DevTools > Application > Cookies. Tokens last one day.

item.name: Owner sees it on the schedule

exec: pm.test("Booking is on the day view", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().bookings.map(b => b.id)).to.include(pm.collectionVariables.get("bookingId")));
